A '''raid''' was conducted in the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] by the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Police Force]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The raid target the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] in the [[Uscru Entertainment District/Legends|Entertainment District]]. During the raid, [[Police officer/Legends|Officer]] [[Raim Tibekk]] killed a Cartel [[Unidentified Hutt Cartel operative|operative]].
